mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to increased policy tightening costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified FEDFUNDS increase, or FEDFUNDS rise is ≤0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) of at least 50,000 jobs predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS rises by ≥50,000, or effect persists only in contractionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (retail sales) of at least 10% followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as the market anticipates bottoming.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops ≥10% in a month then rebounds in the next
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day return after the described pattern, or rebound is not followed by positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO (industrial production) falls for two consecutive months below its 12-month moving average, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 2 consecutive months below 12-mo MA
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such a dual-month decline, or INDPRO recovers before the window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4% for three months indicates labor market resilience, leading to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during the 3-month UNRATE decline, or trigger does not persist.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) exceed their 12-month moving averages simultaneously for the next month, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is predicted to be positive reflecting strong demand.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-mo MA AND RSAFS > 12-mo MA in the following month
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day return (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their MA together, or effect is spurious (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% followed by a sustained increase for 30 days predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate disinflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% for 1 month then increases for 30 days
failure_condition: No positive 20-day return after the described pattern, or inflation reaccelerates before the window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of GDPC1 (GDP) falls by more than 5% from its peak in the prior 12 months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to economic contraction risks.
candidate_trigger: 3-mo GDPC1 MA down >5% from prior 12-mo peak
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such a decline, or contraction is not confirmed by other indicators.
